email.subject: Request for Price Review
email.body:
Dear Harbourline Dry Goods Pte Ltd,

I noticed significant price increases for several items we purchase from you, including cooking oil, plain flour, and jasmine rice. These increases have added substantial costs to our monthly expenses. Could you please review these prices and provide a more competitive quote?

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

Best regards,
[Your name], [Your business]
